readout_other: 18F-FDG microPET; c-Fos immunohistochemistry; targeted LC-HRMS metabolomics; electromyographic motor-evoked potentials used for pressure-response optimisation
direction_notes: Repeated IL-USNS increased local c-Fos expression in the infralimbic cortex (target engagement) and reversed UCMS-induced deficits in nest-building and anxiety-like open-field exploration, with sustained hypermetabolism (FDG-PET) in vmPFC/IL and connected limbic regions.
safety_notes: Furthermore, metabolomic analysis revealed no increase in inflammatory or excitotoxic markers typically associated with tissue damage<sup>54,55</sup>, supporting an excellent safety profile.

exposures.label: Single-pulse pressure-response mapping at primary motor cortex (M1)

timing.protocol_description: Single continuous 160 ms pulses delivered to left M1 at pressures stepped from 50 to 500 kPa in 50 kPa increments, ten pulses per step, repeated every 10 s (0.1 Hz); this inter-pulse repetition corresponds to a stated 1.6% duty cycle across the pulse train (distinct from the internal waveform, which is a single continuous burst per pulse). Motor success (visible forepaw twitch, n=20) and motor-evoked potential amplitude (EMG, n=10) were used to derive a motor threshold of 250 kPa and an optimal plateau at 400 kPa.

exposures.label: Repeated-pulse USNS of the infralimbic cortex (IL)

target.label: infralimbic cortex (IL), rodent homologue of vmPFC

timing.protocol_description: 60 single 160 ms pulses at 400 kPa delivered at 0.1 Hz (every 10 s) over a 10 min session. For focality confirmation (c-Fos), one such session was given to 4 active mice (vs 4 sham-anaesthesia mice); for the chronic UCMS experiment, one session per day was repeated for 5 consecutive days (days 29-33), targeted stereotaxically at bregma +2.0 mm, midline.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Thirty mice were used for setting-up US stimulation parameters with (i) motor cortex stimulation using single-pulse USNS and (ii) one session of repeated-pulse USNS targeted to the IL, while 41 mice underwent the UCMS to assess the efficacy.
source_quotes.randomised: From this timepoint, UCMS mice were assigned using stratified randomisation based on coat state deterioration, ensuring balanced baseline stress levels across groups.
source_quotes.blinding: Cell counting was performed blind to group identity.
source_quotes.anaesthesia: Mice breathed 1.8 L min⁻¹ 100% O₂ with isoflurane (2.5% induction; 1–1.5% maintenance unless otherwise stated).

flags.reason: Given as group-size list per instructions rather than summed: 30 mice for parameter-setting (M1 motor screening n=20 plus EMG n=10, a subset of which were later reused for the 8-mouse IL c-Fos focality experiment), and 15 mice in the chronic IL-USNS treatment arm of the UCMS cohort; other UCMS arms (sham-USNS, vehicle, fluoxetine, non-stressed) did not receive ultrasound.

'Sham-USNS'/'sham controls' are described only as anaesthesia without ultrasound; the paper does not state whether a transducer was placed but powered off or simply absent, so the sham mechanism is not fully described.

Text states 'duty cycle 1.6%' for the repeated 160 ms pulses at 0.1 Hz, but this describes the inter-pulse repetition duty cycle across a pulse train, not the internal pulse waveform (which is a single continuous burst); left null per the continuous-wave rule and described in protocol_description instead.
Varies by experiment: single session for M1 optimisation and the 8-mouse c-Fos focality test, versus 5 consecutive daily sessions for the chronic UCMS IL-USNS group.
